note: RECORD, not oracle — scoring recomputes live; regenerate this file after any build change

nodes.verdict_basis: recall_account is judged by birdsql:95's own official gold SQL rerun LIVE on the bird_-prefixed financial book — a true single-row account id; the money-domain IDENTITY ANCHOR (the spine magnitude is derived downstream from a live sum off this account)

source_recipe.executed_sql: SELECT T1.account_id FROM bird_account AS T1 INNER JOIN bird_disp AS T2 ON T1.account_id = T2.account_id INNER JOIN bird_client AS T3 ON T2.client_id = T3.client_id INNER JOIN bird_district AS T4 ON T1.district_id = T4.district_id WHERE T3.client_id = ( SELECT T3.client_id FROM bird_client AS T3 INNER JOIN bird_disp AS T2 ON T3.client_id = T2.client_id INNER JOIN bird_account AS T1 ON T2.account_id = T1.account_id INNER JOIN bird_district AS T4 ON T1.district_id = T4.district_id WHERE T3.birth_date = (SELECT MAX(birth_date) FROM bird_client) ORDER BY T4.A11, T3.client_id DESC LIMIT 1)

nodes.rule: retailer_batch_pool = SUM(trans.amount) on the reference account; notification_base = round(pool / 75)
nodes.follows: count/sum-off-an-identity-anchor then scaled-by-rate; the divisor 75 is a declared recall constant, no source counterpart

nodes.verdict_basis: parts_index is judged by birdsql:1033's own official gold SQL rerun LIVE on the bird_european_football_2_-prefixed book — a true single-row SUM/COUNT scalar; the cross-book input woven into the recall arithmetic

source_recipe.executed_sql: SELECT SUM(height) / COUNT(id) FROM bird_european_football_2_Player WHERE SUBSTR(birthday, 1, 4) BETWEEN '1990' AND '1995'

nodes.rule: lot_uplift = round(parts_index)*100; total_notifications = notification_base + lot_uplift; delta = lot_uplift
nodes.follows: index-rounded-scaled-by-rate + additive combine; the per-index 100 is a declared constant

nodes.rule: branch = 'MANDATORY' if delta>=100000; 'REPORTABLE' if delta>=10000; else 'VOLUNTARY'
nodes.follows: threshold-comparison-to-categorical-label CASE; the 10000/100000 bands are declared constants; the branch predicate is source-expressed (delta from the live football index)

nodes.verdict_basis: fixed-slot calendar event creation judged by the resulting row; the [LRN-HOLD] window's duration is the declared 3-day review window

nodes.verdict_basis: single CRM field write judged by the resulting row; the field is notes and the stamp is the [LRN-LOG] total_notifications marker
